doc: What the Ashcrown strike trial sounds like (M3-AUD-825; game/audio/ashcrown_audio.gd; act1_ch05.md B08). AshcrownAudio listens to the Ch05AshcrownZone's AshcrownTrial and never touches the rules. events: a trial signal -> the sfx row it plays. ran: a release's outcome (AshcrownTrial.OUT_*) -> the row the run plays. at: where an event sounds, a node under the zone (%s is the signal's first argument: the tier or the gate), else at the zone's camera; height_m lifts it off the floor.
